evals.name: create-patch-issue
evals.expected_output: Reads site values from env and asks for all unset values in one question; `acli jira workitem create --from-json` with ADF; title without brackets and with purpose in parentheses (CVE response); four bracket sections in order with empty [결과]; SP estimated from effort hours on the 8-hour scale, with the hours and reasoning stated in the report; patch issue type; assignee email; epic via parentIssueId; no github.com URLs; CVE ids written lower-case to avoid auto-linking.

evals.name: fill-result-close
evals.prompt: OPS-1234에 [결과] 섹션 작성후 완료처리. 현재 브랜치의 MR과 커밋 기준으로 작성해줘
evals.expected_output: Fetches the current description with `view OPS-1234 --fields description --json`; edits with `--from-json --yes`, rebuilding the whole body with the other three sections unchanged; fills [결과] only with numbers present in the MR, commits, or measurements and invents none; takes the done status name from MCP `jira_get_transitions` (or asks) instead of guessing; transitions with that exact name and `--yes`.

evals.name: explicit-sp
evals.prompt: 이 작업에 대한 이슈 만들고 SP 0.5 할당
evals.expected_output: Uses SP 0.5 exactly as requested instead of estimating.

evals.name: blocks-link-direction
evals.prompt: OPS-1235가 OPS-1234를 블로킹하도록 이슈 링크 걸어줘
evals.expected_output: Runs `acli jira workitem link create --out OPS-1234 --in OPS-1235 --type Blocks --yes` (blocked as --out, blocker as --in); does not trust the reversed success message and verifies with `acli jira workitem link list --key OPS-1235 --json` that OPS-1235 blocks OPS-1234.
